text:
maya: Pushed v3q-int4 to 5% staging now, want a short sanity sweep on MRR, hallucination, latency tail.
andre: baseline window? 6h or 24h?
sasha: 6h for canary smoke, 24h for promote decisions. Our auto-fallback uses 15m rolling.
maya: running 15m quick-smoke against 6h baseline.
smoke-bot: quick-smoke summary:
```
model: v3q-int4
traffic: 5% staging
metrics (15m rolling vs 6h baseline):
  MRR_delta: -0.9%
  latency_p50: +2ms
  latency_p95: +6ms
  latency_p99: +12ms
  halluc_rate: +0.6pp
  sample_count: 4200
  p_value(MRR): 0.04
```
maya: p99 +12ms and halluc +0.6pp are concerning but under current hard thresholds.
andre: current hard rule = MRR_drop >1.0% OR halluc_inc >1.0pp OR p99_inc >25ms -> immediate rollback (15m).
sasha: can we avoid hard flips? proposing soft-step first to avoid oscillation.
maya: propose two-stage fallback: soft if any metric >= soft thresholds (MRR_drop >=0.7% OR halluc >=0.5pp OR p99 >=10ms) for 15m -> reduce to 1% for 30m and alert. hard-rollback if metric persists beyond hard thresholds (MRR_drop >=1.0% OR halluc >=1.0pp OR p99 >=25ms) for 10m at 1% traffic.
oliver: +1. Also require either (a) single metric beyond hard OR (b) two metrics beyond soft to trigger hard.
sasha: add statistical guard: sample_count >=1000 or p_value <0.05 for MRR-based hard decisions. If samples <1k, only soft-degrade allowed.
maya: agreed, add `min_samples` and p-value check.
andre: infra changes: router config needs `soft_thresholds`, `hard_thresholds`, `soft_hold_minutes`, `hard_hold_minutes`, `min_samples`. I'll update rollout-config schema and tests.
smoke-bot: tagging @sasha @andre @oliver -> current state: soft thresholds hit (p99 +12ms, halluc +0.6pp), sample_count 4200 -> auto soft-degrade to 1% applied.
maya: applying policy patch and will monitor dash for 15m.
andre: I'll add unit tests for min_samples and p-value gating.
oliver: make sure reason codes are logged in traces (reason=soft-degrade/hard-rollback) for Redwood Console filtering.
maya: filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-ONB-1234 for router + runbook updates.
smoke-bot: deploy-bot: routing-change applied -> v3q-int4 = 1% (soft-degrade) at 1767539500.
sasha: schedule quick sync 10m to re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
